name: meetup_search_events
description: Search Meetup for upcoming public events by keyword, near a city or a lat/lon point. Returns each event's title, time, URL, status and hosting group — never attendee or RSVP lists. Provide either `city` (geocoded automatically) or `lat`+`lon`.

query.description: Keyword to search for, e.g. "music" or "python".

city.description: City or place name to search near, e.g. "San Francisco, CA". Geocoded automatically. Omit if you pass lat/lon directly.

lat.description: Latitude of the search center, in decimal degrees. Use instead of `city`.

lon.description: Longitude of the search center, in decimal degrees. Use instead of `city`.

radius.description: Search radius in miles around the center point. Defaults to 25.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (1-50). Defaults to 10.

name: meetup_event
description: Get full details for one Meetup event by its numeric ID (the trailing number in a meetup.com event URL, e.g. "316887506"). Returns title, description, time, venue and hosting group — never attendee or RSVP lists.

event_id.description: The event's numeric Meetup ID, e.g. "316887506".

name: meetup_group
description: Get details for one Meetup group by its urlname (the slug in meetup.com/<urlname>, e.g. "sfpython"). Returns name, description, location, topic category and founding date — never a member list.

name: meetup_group_events
description: List a Meetup group's events by the group's urlname. Returns upcoming events by default, or past events with `include_past`. Never returns RSVP or attendee lists.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (1-50). Defaults to 10.

include_past.description: When true, list the group's past events instead of its upcoming ones. Defaults to false.
